entries.source:
Your Rethread now braids the lifelines of all targets it hits for %d turns.  Braided targets take %d%% of all damage dealt to other braided targets.
		The amount of damage shared will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你的重编时间线技能会将所有命中目标的生命线编织在一起，持续 %d 回合。受影响的生物将承受其他受影响生物所受伤害的 %d%%。
		共享伤害的比例受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Realign and readjust your body with the power of your mind, curing up to %d detrimental physical effects and healing you for %d life.
		The life healed increases with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
用你的精神力量校准并调整你的身体，移除最多 %d 个负面物理状态，并恢复 %d 点生命值。
		治疗量受精神强度加成。
